name: XOR_Hash_Weight_Equality
description: Transforms the explicit pairwise conflict condition into an N-ary constraint on the XOR sum of binary strings. The weight of the XOR sum equals the sum of individual weights if and only if no two selected strings share a 1 in any position. This requires the model to perform a mathematical deduction to recover the pairwise independent set condition, preventing simple pattern matching on the problem description.
